name: Volumetric Path Tracing Estimator Derivation
aliases: Monte Carlo Estimator for Volumetric Path Tracing
definition: A Monte Carlo estimator for the generalized path contribution function $\hat{P}$ for an $n$ vertex path with $m$ real-scattering vertices, based on three sampling operations: distance sampling, event type selection, and direction sampling.
summary: Volumetric Path Tracing Estimator Derivation simplifies the Monte Carlo path contribution estimator by canceling sampling probabilities against phase functions and extinction coefficients, yielding a product of phase function ratios and emission.
